falseSynonyms.zh: 公園不等於 garden park 通常面積較大，主要作公共休憩、運動或自然空間；garden 常更細緻地種植和管理。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A park and a garden can overlap, but they are not the same category.

falseSynonyms.zh: 草坪不等於 garden lawn 只是鋪草的一片地，通常是 garden 的一部分。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A lawn can be part of a garden.

falseSynonyms.zh: 田地不等於 garden field 通常較大，用於農業、牧養或開放土地用途。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A field is usually larger and more agricultural or open.

falseSynonyms.zh: 農場不等於 garden farm 是生產規模更大的農業經營單位。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A farm is a production enterprise, not simply a garden.

falseSynonyms.zh: 果園不等於所有 garden orchard 專門種果樹，是特定種植地類型。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An orchard is specifically for fruit trees.

falseSynonyms.zh: 溫室不等於 garden greenhouse 是覆蓋式種植結構；它可以位於 garden 內。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A greenhouse is a structure within or beside a garden.

falseSynonyms.zh: yard 只在住宅戶外空間 sense 接近 garden yard 可以是草地、鋪地或空院，未必有種植。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A yard may contain a garden but need not be one.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞性陷阱 garden 是名詞，也可作動詞；gardening 是園藝活動。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A garden is the place; gardening is the activity.
